BREAKING: Heavy traffic is reported along Padre Burgos Avenue in front of Kartilya ng Katipunan in Manila after an SUV crashed into a road barricade around 12 a.m. on February 8.

Authorities said the driver was immediately rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, a tow truck is being awaited so that it could tow the SUV from the area.

No passengers were on board at the time of the incident. | via Diann Calucin

🍔  Cities with highest consumption of burgers

1.🇺🇸 Las Vegas, USA
Highest global density with 21.5 burger shops per capita.

2.🇺🇸 New York City, USA
Massive volume driven by high-traffic global burger icons.

3.🇺🇸 Chicago, USA
Deeply rooted fast-food culture and iconic gourmet styles.

4.🇬🇧 London, UK
Europe’s leading hub for premium craft burger innovation.

5.🇺🇸 Houston, USA
Huge per-capita intake with dominant regional chains.

6.🇺🇸 Los Angeles, USA
High market volume and birthplace of smash burgers.

7.🇦🇺 Sydney, Australia
Booming craft scene fueled by high meat consumption.

8.🇫🇷 Paris, France
Massive McDonald’s market, outpacing traditional French bakery items.

9.🇺🇸 Richmond, USA
Statistically holds the highest restaurant-to-resident burger ratio.

10.🇯🇵 Tokyo, Japan
Rapid growth mixing Western brands and local fusion.

11.🇪🇸 Barcelona, Spain
Home to the world’s current top-ranked burger restaurant.

12.🇦🇷 Buenos Aires, Argentina
Traditional high beef intake meeting modern burger trends.

13.🇵🇭 Manila, Philippines
High demand for American styles and local favorites.

14.🇩🇪 Berlin, Germany
Dense concentration of shops with strong historical ties.

15.🇰🇷 Seoul, South Korea
Gen Z driving demand for “Instagrammable” premium burgers.
